components.name: Default button
components.css: .ds-default{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--control-line,#608491);border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink,#050809);background:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-family:'PinIt Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;line-height:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),background-color 150ms ease;}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-default:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--panel,#d9eff5)}}.ds-default:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#064c68);outline-offset:3px}.ds-default:active:not(:disabled):not(:focus-visible){transform:translateY(2px)}.ds-default:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;color:#627a84;border-color:#b5cad2;background:#dae7ec}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-default{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-default{transition-duration:0ms}}

components.name: Numeric field

components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;max-width:220px;color:var(--muted,#355866);font-family:'PinIt Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:17px}.ds-field>span:first-child{font-weight:550}.ds-unit{display:block;position:relative}.ds-unit input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:38px;padding:8px 34px 8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--control-line,#608491);border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink,#050809);background:var(--surface,#ffffff);font-family:'PinIt Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:20px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;caret-color:var(--action,#075672)}.ds-unit input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#064c68);outline-offset:3px}.ds-unit input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--danger,#a12a29)}.ds-unit small{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:10px;pointer-events:none}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-unit input{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Floating tool dock
components.description: Resting dock with actual view/action semantics. App owns GSAP magnification; snippet needs no framework.
components.css: .ds-dock{display:inline-block;padding:9px 18px 6px;border-radius:22px;background:#103e52;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgb(8 56 77 / 15%);font-family:'PinIt Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-dock ul{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.ds-dock li{height:70px;width:48px;flex:none}.ds-dock-button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:7px;width:48px;height:70px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:white;cursor:pointer}.ds-dock-button:hover,.ds-dock-button:active{background:transparent;transform:none}.ds-tile{display:grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;flex:none;border-radius:12px;background:#28677e;color:white;transform-origin:center bottom;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 30%),0 3px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%)}.ds-selected .ds-tile{background:var(--bright,#69c5e2);color:var(--ink,#050809)}.ds-dock-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:14px;color:#d0e7ef}.ds-selected .ds-dock-label{color:white}.ds-dock-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--bright,#69c5e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-dock-button:disabled{opacity:.5;color:#93b3c0;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:1250px){.ds-dock{padding-block:6px 3px}.ds-dock li,.ds-dock-button{height:66px}}

narrative.overview:
PinIt is a pin-making workbench assembled from connected cyan and sky blocks. Substantial Geist typography, near-black ink, rounded external corners and molded circular studs translate the actual inspiration into a practical offline Windows editor. The user explicitly approved this visual and structural replacement; it supersedes the earlier Nunito, loose-reference and three-column system.

Flat joined modules carry the work, while CSS lighting gives the pinned stud geometry its material identity. White paper remains distinct from the colored editing ground. The supplied Mac-style dock is a functional tool switcher with visible labels, reserved space and motion that yields immediately to keyboard focus, coarse pointers and reduced-motion preference. The shipped code is the authority; no approved visual comp or Figma artifact is claimed.
keyCharacteristics: Connected rectangular cyan/sky modules with rounded external corners.
Locally bundled Geist under the PinIt Sans alias; strong task headings and compact utility text.
CSS molded studs and a dark floating dock as the deliberate material signatures.
Large artwork stage, horizontal artwork shelf, disclosed exact adjustments and persistent white sheet preview.
Independent physical geometry, numeric alternatives, visible keyboard states and local operational feedback.

rules.name: The Working Color Rule
rules.body: Use molded cyan and sky for the joined work modules, deep action blue with white text for primary/export actions, near-black for working text, and lemon for the passive print-scale reminder.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use the locally bundled Geist variable face through PinIt Sans. Keep substantial headings and compact operational copy in the same family; the old Nunito files are neither referenced nor bundled.

rules.name: The Molded Material Rule
rules.body: Keep the connected work modules flat. Lighting gradients and inset shadows belong to the pinned circular studs; cast lift belongs to their blocks, the empty pin, white paper, dock, dialogs and export progress.

dos: **Do** use the shipped Geist family, actual palette and connected block corner assignments.
**Do** preserve the persistent sheet preview while changing Artwork, Sheet or Library views.
**Do** expose exact numeric adjustments beside the canvas on desktop and above it in the narrow fallback.
**Do** pair color feedback with text, visible focus, associated invalid-field explanations and useful disabled states.
**Do** preserve independent face/cut dimensions and keep editor alignment overlays outside exported artwork.
**Do** keep the four dock labels and native button semantics, focus navigation, reduced-motion handling and reserved bay.
**Do** draw studs with CSS geometry and light; preserve source artwork as local user content.
donts: **Don't** restore the obsolete Nunito, generic three-column or loose-reference rules as preservation requirements.
**Don't** turn every module into a detached card, round internal joined edges or spread the stud gradient treatment to ordinary controls.
**Don't** use customer artwork, inspiration rasters, synthetic review artwork or native-icon colors as design tokens.
**Don't** print transformer handles, snap lines or center dots, or change physical dimensions to fit a screen or sheet.
**Don't** let dock magnification move keyboard controls, run for coarse pointers or reduced motion, or cover editing content.
**Don't** treat the defensive narrow-browser stack as native mobile support; Windows remains the supported desktop target.
**Don't** reuse the 9px missing-thumbnail annotation as a general text size or canonize unused micro-label selectors into new UI.
